human_sources.role: The passage from isotropy comparison to measurable groupoid comparison is the method of [ST], Section 4. Its proof retains a further mixed scalar character and cancels it using a model action. The programme gluing theorem used here instead assumes actual phase-compatible isotropy pairs and retains their entire unitary coordinates through the finite exhaustion. Its equations (6.3)–(6.7) prove the mixed identity needed for the genuine whole-groupoid cocycle. The selector below supplies exactly those stronger initial data.
